compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-6: plugins/dso/config/visual-evaluator-params.yaml records model id, temperature, thinking_budget, max_tokens, image_resolution; agent references this file

## Implementation Notes
File plugins/dso/config/visual-evaluator-params.yaml already exists from spike story 7ff8-04f4-a60c-4cc2 with:
  model_id: claude-sonnet-4-6, temperature: 0, thinking_budget: 8000, max_tokens: 16000, image_resolution: {primary: 1280x800}

This task confirms the file has all 5 required keys and tests pass. No new file to create — tests/plugin/test_visual_evaluator_params.py already covers this. Update: verify the existing test confirms dd-6 requirements. If any key is missing, update the YAML.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] YAML exists and is parseable
  Verify: python3 -c 'import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open("plugins/dso/config/visual-evaluator-params.yaml"))'
- [ ] All 5 required keys present (model_id, temperature, thinking_budget, max_tokens, image_resolution)
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/plugin/test_visual_evaluator_params.py -v
- [ ] max_tokens exceeds thinking_budget (API requirement)
  Verify: python3 -c 'import yaml; d=yaml.safe_load(open("plugins/dso/config/visual-evaluator-params.yaml")); assert d["max_tokens"]>d["thinking_budget"], f"{d[\"max_tokens\"]} not > {d[\"thinking_budget\"]}"'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
